title: Mass, prayer and devotion
tagline: Why Mass and ritual, “vain repetition”, the Latin Mass, how to pray and Eucharistic adoration.
whyItMatters: Many people stay away from Mass because it feels like ritual, or want to pray but do not know how. Answering well also helps Catholics love what they do.

mindset.tip: Listen to the honest worry behind “it is boring” or “it is just ritual” before answering.
Show that Jesus prayed, repeated words and kept feasts. (Matthew 26:44; Luke 22:19)
Be even-handed on the Latin Mass; Catholics who love it and those who do not are both sincere.
Offer to pray together rather than just explain. (Matthew 18:20)
